verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is a cap-table SaaS, so user-defined recurring jobs or workflows are a fair axis for it. The evidence never documents any user-configurable scheduler or recurring workflow. The vesting engine's automated 'schedules' are equity vesting schedules, and the registered-agent notifications are event-triggered one-off actions, not recurring jobs; both are adjacent features that earn no credit. The MCP integration is documented as read-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
